description: The checkout seat check validates `seats < 1 || seats > 500` but does not assert `Number.isInteger(seats)`, so a fractional value like 2.5 passes validation and is forwarded to Stripe as line-item quantity.
reason: billing-routes.ts:97 only checks `typeof seats !== 'number' || seats < 1 || seats > 500`, and seats is passed unmodified into createCheckoutSession (billing.service.ts:125 `quantity: seats`), so a non-integer like 2.5 passes route validation; low impact since Stripe rejects non-integer quantity, but the missing Number.isInteger check is real.
